purpose: Structured intake ledger for the human-observed 1.0 ship-gate evidence that no machine audit can produce: main-quest full-coverage runtime/display probes, Experience Mode smoke, compatibility acceptance, and Requiem Track B felt sweeps. Read by tools/pdv_1_0_endstate_gate.mjs.

rules.slotShape: status / expected / note (dated ISO entries, newest last)
rules.recordingRule: Record evidence only after the observation actually happened in game or the maintainer acceptance actually arrived. Never pre-fill.

mq106SyrabaneRouteAndDisplay.expected: On clean state, setstage MQ106 200 lands the reachable Syrabane row; capture the Papyrus route marker separately from Book of Days, strongest-only toast, and Survey/status evidence.

mq206MixedValenceRouteAndDisplay.expected: On clean state, setstage MQ206 220 lands reachable Peryite gain and Mehrunes Dagon loss in one logical event; capture route, aggregated Book entry, strongest-only toast, and repeat behavior.

mq101SheogorathAliasRouteAndDisplay.expected: On clean state, setstage MQ101 150 resolves Sheogorath through the runtime Sheo alias without a silent drop; capture route and player-facing surfaces.

mq105PairedEquityRouteAndDisplay.expected: On clean state, setstage MQ105 160 lands Kynareth C+ milestone and Kyne S+ stepdown; capture route and player-facing surfaces without inventing a Kyne-C cell.

paarthurnaxExpandedForksAndLatches.expected: From clean latch states, prove the expanded 17-kill and 11-spare Paarthurnax rosters through MCM debug and one organic route each; Book of Days lists every reachable landed god, toast shows only the strongest reactor, and repeat plus kill-then-spare suppression survive save/load.
paarthurnaxExpandedForksAndLatches.note: The pre-T11 6-kill/4-spare controlled proof and owner waivers do not satisfy this slot.
